title: DondiMod
description: This mod adds a Netherite Duplication craft and some hungarian musics
body:
DondiMod adds a small set of fun custom items to your Minecraft world, including two unique music discs and a special crafting recipe.

✨ Features

🎵 New Music Discs

Döndi Duo – “Álmodtam egy világot”

Rostás Szabika – “Vettem a piacon”

Each disc comes with its own custom track, letting you bring a bit of extra personality into your world.

🛠️ Netherite Duplication Recipe
Adds a custom recipe that allows players to duplicate Netherite using specific materials. Perfect for late-game progression or modpack creators who want a more flexible resource system.

📦 Version

Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge

💬 Notes

This mod is lightweight and designed for fun, casual use or small modpacks. More features may be added in the future.
